```sql
WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.emp_no, 
        e.first_name, 
        e.last_name, 
        COUNT(DISTINCT de.dept_no) AS department_count
    FROM 
        employees e 
    JOIN 
        dept_emp de ON de.emp_no = e.emp_no 
    GROUP BY 
        e.emp_no, e.first_name, e.last_name
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT de.dept_no) > 1
), department_names AS (
    SELECT 
        de.emp_no, 
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.dept_name ORDER BY d.dept_name SEPARATOR ', ') AS departments
    FROM 
        dept_emp de 
    JOIN 
        departments d ON d.dept_no = de.dept_no 
    GROUP BY 
        de.emp_no
)
SELECT 
    dc.emp_no, 
    dc.first_name, 
    dc.last_name, 
    dc.department_count, 
    dn.departments
FROM 
    department_counts dc
JOIN 
    department_names dn ON dc.emp_no = dn.emp_no
ORDER BY 
    dc.emp_no;
```
